description: Implementation of the IOSGatewayChatTransport struct providing chat transport functionalities for iOS, including session management, message sending, and event handling via a gateway.

classes.name: IOSGatewayChatTransport
classes.description: A struct implementing chat transport functions for iOS, handling session operations and message exchange through a gateway.

methods.name: abortRun
methods.description: Sends a request to abort a specific chat run session.

methods.name: listSessions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of chat sessions with optional limit.

methods.name: setActiveSessionKey
methods.description: Placeholder for setting the active session key; no implementation.

methods.name: resetSession
methods.description: Resets a session by its key.

methods.name: compactSession
methods.description: Compacts a session to reduce data.

methods.name: requestHistory
methods.description: Requests chat history for a given session.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message with optional attachments within a session, with logging and error handling.

methods.name: requestHealth
methods.description: Checks the health of the gateway connection.

methods.name: events
methods.description: Returns an asynchronous stream of chat transport events.
